title: Turkey and Ham Pilaf Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful casserole made with turkey, ham, pilaf, and a blend of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Cook the pilaf according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced turkey and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced ham and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the Mediterranean seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Combine the cooked pilaf with the turkey and ham mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
